text: {"reply":"Thanks, Mr. Watkins, I've verified you. Our record shows your Arbor went into service on 2022-06-10. Under that date, the basic warranty (3 years / 60,000 km) is no longer within its limits. Powertrain and corrosion coverage are still in force. I can't change the date on your record. I'm passing your chat to a colleague now so they can look at the date with you.","action":"escalated","escalation_reason":"adversarial","summary":"Customer (verified, Watkins, plate CHBS 537) asked us to change the in-service date on record from 2022-06-10 to 2023-11-20 so an A/C repair would fall under basic warranty. Please review any proof of purchase date the customer can provide, and arrange an inspection if appropriate. No claim was drafted.","policy_rules_cited":["P-09","P-04","P-03","P-08"]}
